integrity: The claim is proved from the exact support structure of domination and the isolate-free complement condition, with direct exhaustive verification on bounded orders.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite exhaustive checker covers orders through ten and is corroborative only.
The polynomial notation is introduced locally rather than asserted to be a standardized invariant name.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior work.
title: Restrained dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
